mail.description: one letter's envelope, sent or received

to.description: the address it is written to — absent when `deliver.to` names the recipient as an entity instead

at.description: when it was written, or when it arrived

target.description: the entity this letter is about — any entity at all, so correspondence hangs off the thing it concerns

message_id.description: the Message-ID the world knows this letter by — written from what arrived, and what a reply threads on

verified.description: whether the sending domain signed for this letter (DKIM) — false is recorded, never dropped: a letter nobody signed for is still a letter, and the reader is the one who decides what to trust

email.description: an address, as an entity — what a person is reachable at

deliver.description: who a letter is for, as an entity in your graph

to.description: the recipient — their address is looked up when the letter goes out

delivered.description: the letter left: half of the outcome pair

via.description: how it went — the id the sender gave it back, or the address it went to

bounced.description: the letter did not leave: the other half

reason.description: what went wrong, as the sender said it

notified.description: a recipient was told about something
